en.headline: Ta Teh Institute exhibition opens at Hong Kong Museum of History
en.dek: The free show on the short-lived Tuen Mun liberal arts college runs until 15 February and includes artefacts displayed in the city for the first time.
body: A new exhibition on the education legacy of Ta Teh Institute has opened at the Hong Kong Museum of History. The free show, titled "Cultivation and Renewal – The Education Legacy of Hong Kong’s Ta Teh Institute", runs until 15 February 2027 in the Moonchu Historical Images and Culture Gallery.

Ta Teh Institute was a full-time liberal arts university established in Tuen Mun in 1946 under the leadership of the Guangdong District Committee of the Communist Party of China. It operated until 1949 and was the second university in Hong Kong after the University of Hong Kong. The exhibition marks the 80th anniversary of its founding.

Presented by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department, the display features more than 60 sets of artefacts related to the institute and its alumni, together with about 125 historical photographs. It includes materials from the Memorial Museum of Comrade Mao Zedong Sponsoring the Peasant Movement Institute and explores campus life, teaching and the later contributions of staff and students.

zh.headline: 達德學院展覽在香港歷史博物館開幕
zh.dek: 免費展覽介紹1946至1949年屯門文科大學的歷史，展期至明年2月15日，部分展品首次在港展出。
body: 香港歷史博物館今日起舉辦「文化新民 — 香港達德學院育才之路」展覽，介紹達德學院的教育遺產。展覽在夢周歷史影像暨文化館舉行，免費入場，展期至2027年2月15日。
達德學院是1946年在屯門創辦的全日制文科大學，由中共廣東區黨委領導，與愛國民主人士合作開辦，至1949年結束，是香港大學之後的第二所大學。今年適逢學院創立八十周年。
展覽由康樂及文化事務署呈獻，展出逾60件（套）與學院及校友相關的文物，以及約125件（套）歷史照片。展品來自毛澤東同志主辦農民運動講習所舊址紀念館等，呈現校園生活、教學情況及師生後來的貢獻。
